FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current ORDER BY sqm DESC LIMIT 16)
   OR store_id>=900
ORDER BY store_id, valid_from

WITH nl AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT store_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN v END) AS ns_fy2526,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN v END) AS ns_ytd2627,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-06' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN v END) AS ns_52w
  FROM nl GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format, cs.sqm, cs.open_date, cs.close_date,
  ROUND(a.ns_fy2526,0) ns_fy2526, ROUND(a.ns_ytd2627,0) ns_ytd2627, ROUND(a.ns_52w,0) ns_52w,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.sqm DESC) r_sqm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.ns_fy2526 DESC) r_fy, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.ns_ytd2627 DESC) r_ytd, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.ns_52w DESC) r_52
FROM dim_store cs LEFT JOIN agg a USING (store_id)
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900
ORDER BY r_fy

WITH nl AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(v) AS mine FROM nl GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
dups AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03') AS n_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03') AS n_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03') AS n_rl)
SELECT m.store_id, ROUND(m.mine,2) mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) ctl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctl,2) gap, d.n_rows, d.n_ids, d.n_rl
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c USING(store_id) CROSS JOIN dups d
ORDER BY ABS(m.mine-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) DESC
LIMIT 12

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) dup_rows, SUM(f.net_amount) dup_net, MIN(f.sale_date) mind, MAX(f.sale_date) maxd,
       MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) max_load, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-04-28' AS start_date, DATE '2026-05-03' AS end_date),
sales_dedup AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f, params
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r CROSS JOIN params JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
),
store_sales AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, params WHERE business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(ss.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_eur, ROUND(c.ctl,2) AS ctl, cs.sqm
FROM store_sales ss JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank LIMIT 12
